arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike patterns in memory or files"
        author = "SOC Team"
        false_positive_rate = "high"
        recommended_action = "tune_entropy_threshold"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 73 00 76 00 63 00 68 00 6F 00 73 00 74 } // "svchost" wide string
        $b = { BE ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 8B ?? 6A 00 } // Common shellcode pattern
        $c = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and ( $a or ( $b and $c ) ) and filesize < 500KB
}

            - '\\cipher.exe'
    condition: selection and entropy_check and not negative_selection
falsepositives:

level: medium

arguments.summary: Post-exploitation activity detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14) attributed to user CORP\jsmith. Investigation revealed a multi-stage compromise initiated via phishing (T1566.001), leading to execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon (T1071.001) through encoded PowerShell launched from Outlook. The attacker established persistence via an unsigned DLL loaded from the Temp directory (T1218.011) and modified the hosts file (T1565.001) to potentially block security updates. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to host 10.0.3.190. The sandbox initially misclassified the sample as benign due to limited execution time, but SIEM and EDR data confirmed malicious activity. The C2 infrastructure (198.51.100.23) is confirmed malicious.

title: Suspicious rundll32 Execution from User Temp Directory
id: 5a1b2c3d-4e5f-6a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
description: Detects rundll32 loading a DLL from a user's Temp directory, a common technique for executing malicious payloads.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1218.011
    - attack.s0107
date: 2026-04-09
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
        OriginalFileName: 'rundll32.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 
            - '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\'
            - '\\AppData\\Roaming\\'
            - '\\Temp\\'
    condition: selection
level: high

rule Suspicious_PowerShell_From_Office {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell launched with common malicious flags from Office applications"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $encoded = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $hidden = "-w hidden" nocase
        $nop = "-nop" nocase
        $office_parent = "winword.exe" nocase
        $office_parent2 = "excel.exe" nocase
        $office_parent3 = "outlook.exe" nocase
    condition:
        all of ($office_parent*) and all of ($nop, $hidden, $encoded)
}
